name: base
title: Mantis Base
description: The Mantis token layer (one dark, cinematic theme: the reference's source tokens plus semantic roles) and the core component set. Install this first; it is the one-install entry point for the design system.

meta.usage:
Install this item first, then blocks. Mantis ships ONE theme, and it is dark. FIVE MANUAL STEPS the CLI does not do for you. KEEP the `@import "shadcn/tailwind.css";` that `shadcn init` adds: the components' horizontal/vertical layouts depend on its variants.

1) IMPORT THE THEME. `shadcn add` copies `app/mantis-theme.css` into your app but never adds the import. Add `@import "./mantis-theme.css";` to `app/globals.css`, next to its other `@import` rules at the very top (CSS requires `@import` to precede all other rules).

2) REMOVE `shadcn init`'s COMPETING BLOCK. It writes its own `:root { … }` / `.dark { … }` into the same `globals.css` with the same variable names. From `:root`, delete every property this theme also defines (`--background`, `--foreground`, `--card`, `--popover`, `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--muted`, `--accent`, `--destructive`, `--border`, `--input`, `--ring` and their `-foreground` pairs). Delete the `.dark { … }` block ENTIRELY: nothing in Mantis applies a `.dark` class. KEEP `--chart-*`, `--sidebar-*` and `--radius` (a fallback if the import ever fails). Change `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *));` to `@custom-variant dark (&:where([data-theme="dark"], [data-theme="dark"] *));`. In the `@theme inline` block, delete the `--radius-*` lines, `--font-sans` and `--font-mono`: this theme defines them exactly, and yours would win because it comes later.

3) SET `data-theme="dark"` ON `<html>`, and add `:root { color-scheme: dark; }` so native scrollbars and form controls render dark. Every `dark:` utility inside the installed primitives keys off `data-theme`. With `next-themes`, use `attribute="data-theme"` and `forcedTheme="dark"`.

4) LOAD THE FONTS WITH A STYLESHEET, NOT next/font. The theme names the families literally: Inter (body, `font-sans`), Inter Display (headings, `font-display`; Inter's optical-size axis provides it), Space Grotesk (`font-grotesk`) and IBM Plex Mono (`font-mono`). next/font renames families internally, so `font-grotesk` and friends would silently fall back to system-ui. Put this in your root layout's `<head>`: `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:opsz,wght@14..32,400..900&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400..700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" />` (plus preconnects to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), and remove the Geist fonts `shadcn init` added.

5) BUTTON ROLES. `bg-primary` is WHITE, the everyday action (Save, Invite, Continue). The lime brand color is reserved for the generate/create action and for focus and selection; never use lime for ordinary buttons.

AGENT GUIDE. This item also installs `MANTIS.md`, the index AI coding agents should read before writing UI with Mantis: components, props, tokens and rules. Add `Read MANTIS.md before building UI.` to your AGENTS.md, and `@MANTIS.md` to CLAUDE.md if you use Claude Code.

ICONS. This item also installs `icon`: Google Material Symbols as `<Icon name="close" />`. Only the names this system ships are available; pass `label` when an icon is a control's only content.

TABS CONTRAST. If your installed `components/ui/tabs.tsx` still has `text-foreground/60`, replace it with `text-muted-foreground`; a 60%-opacity label cannot reach 4.5:1.

NO LIGHT MODE, SO NO LIGHT ISLAND. The theme emits its only mode at `html:root`. A `<div data-theme="light">` does NOT switch back to anything: there are no light values to switch to.

OVERRIDING A VARIABLE. Write `html:root { --primary: … }`, NOT `:root { … }`. The theme ships at `html:root` (specificity 0,1,1), so a bare `:root` override (0,1,0) silently loses regardless of source order.

RADIUS, TYPE AND SHADOW ARE EXACT. This theme's `@theme inline` block maps `rounded-*`, `text-*` and `shadow-*` to Mantis's exact values. Spacing is Tailwind's default scale, which Mantis matches exactly (space-400 = p-4 = 16px).
